title: Seahawks vs. Patriots: Why the NFL season is opening on a Wednesday for just the second time in 107 years

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks vs. Patriots: Why the NFL season is opening on a Wednesday for just the second time in 107 years
sources.description: The league shifted the Patriots-Seahawks rematch to Wednesday so the defending champions could open the season ahead of a Thursday night kickoff in Australia.
